|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Leia's game text may not be canceled. While at opponent's Galactic Senate, may lose 1 Force to place Leia and any character present out of play. Once per battle at same location, may cancel gametext of opponent's leader of ability < 5 present for remainder of turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Leia (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “While at opponent’s Senate, Leia’s game text may not be canceled and may lose 1 Force to place Leia and a character present out of play. During battle, may cancel game text of a leader of ability < 5 with Leia for remainder of turn.” '''What changed:''' “Leia's” → “While at opponent’s Senate, Leia’s”; “canceled. While at opponent's Galactic Senate,” → “canceled and”; “any” → “a”; “Once per battle at same location,” → “During battle,”; “gametext” → “game text”; “opponent's” → “a”; “present” → “with Leia”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 25. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Leia (Jedi Pack)]].
* Later text: [[Leia (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Leia (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Leia (Jedi Pack)]].
